verses.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.sm: Ua fai le tupu o Solomona ma tupu ia Isaraelu uma.

verses.en: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.sm: O alii nei sa ia te ia; O Asaraia le atalii o Satoka le faitaulaga;

verses.en: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.sm: 0 Eliorefa ma Akia, o atalii o Sesa, o tusiupu ia; o Iosefatu le atalii o Ailuta, o le fatua‘iupu;

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.sm: o Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, o le pule i ‘au; o Satoka ma Aviata, o faitaulaga ia;

verses.en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
verses.sm: o Asaraia le atalii o Natano, o le pule i e na tofia e pule; ma Saputo le atalii o Natano, o le faipule, o le uo a le tupu ia;

verses.en: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
verses.sm: o Akisaro, o le pule i le aiga; ma Atoniramo le atalii o Apeta, o lé pule i taulaga.

verses.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.sm: Sa ia Solomona e na tofia e pule e toasefulu ma le toalua i Isaraelu uma lava, o e fagaina le tupu ma lona aiga; o le tagata ma lona masina i lea tausaga ma lea tausaga e fafaga mai ai.

verses.en: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.sm: O latou igoa foi nei; o le atalii o Huro, i le mauga O Efaraima.

verses.en: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:
verses.sm: O le atalii o Tikeru, i Makasa, ma Salapima, ma Petesemesa, ma Aluna-petana.

verses.en: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.sm: O le atalii o Heseta i Arupoto; sa ia te ia o Suka, atoa ma le nuu uma o Eferu.

verses.en: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.sm: O le atalii o Apinatapa sa ia te ia le nuu maualuga uma o Toro; o lana aya o Tafata o le afafine o Solomona.

verses.en: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
verses.sm: O Paana, le atalii o Ailuta sa ia te ia o Tanaka, ma Mekito, ma Peteseana uma lava, e lata ane lea i Saratana i lalo o Isereelu, e pau mai i Peteseana, a e gata atu i Apelemeoloa, e 00 i tala atu o lokameama.

verses.en: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.sm: O le atalii o Kipera i Ramota-kiliata, sa ia te ia aai o lairo le atalii o Manase ua i Kiliata, sa ia te ia foi le ituo Arakopo ua i Vasana, o aai tetele e onogafulu, ua i ai pa ma faamaufaalava “apa memea.

verses.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
verses.sm: O Akinatapu le atalii o Ito, sa ia te ia o Maanaima.

verses.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.sm: O Aimaasu, i Nafatali, na fai avá foi o ia ia Pase498 meta le afafine o Solomona.

verses.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.sm: O Paana le atalii o Husai, i Asera ma Alota.

verses.en: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.sm: O Iosefatu le atalii o Parua, i Isakara.

verses.en: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.sm: O Semi le atalii o Ala, i Peniamina.

verses.en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
verses.sm: O Kipera le atalii o Uri, i le nuu o Kiliata le nuu o Sekono le tupu o sa Amori, ma Oko le tupu o Vasana, ua tofia o ia e pule e toatasi i le nuu.

verses.en: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.sm: Ua toatele Iuta ma Isaraelu, e pei o le oneone i le matafaga ona toatele, o loo aai, ma feinu, ma olioli.

verses.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.sm: Ua pule foi Solomona i malo uma e gata mai i le vaitafe, e pau mai i le nuu o Filisitia, e 00 foi i le tuaoi o Aikupito; ua latou aumaia foi mea alofa, ma latou auauna ia Solomona i aso uma o lona ola.

verses.en: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.sm: O mea e “ai a Solomona, o le aso ma le tolugafulu o kori o falaoa lelei, ma le onogafulu o kori o isi falaoa;

verses.en: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.sm: o povi pepeti e sefulu, ma povi tataa E luafulu, ma mamoe e selau; i le ma aila, ma sevi, ma imura, ma parepuri pepeti.

verses.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.sm: Aua na ia te ia le pule i nuu uma i tala mai o le vaitafe, e gata mai i Tipesa, e pau mai i Kasa, o tupu uma i tala mai o le vaitafe. Sa ia te ia le filemu i itu uma na vagavagai ia te ia.

verses.en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.sm: Sa nonofo ma le filemu o Iuta ma Isaraelu; e taitasi ma nofo i lalo o lona vine, ma lalo o lona mati, e gata mai i Tanu, e pau mai i Peresepa, i ona po uma o Solomona.

verses.en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.sm: Sa ia Solomona mea e nonofo ai solofanua e fa sefulu o afe mo kariota sa ia te ia, ma e tietie i solofanua e sefulu afe ma afe e lua.

verses.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.sm: O e na tofia e pule sa latou fafaga i le tupu o Solomona, ma i latou uma o e na o mai i le laulau a le tupu o Solomona; ua latou taitasi ma lona lava masina; ua le tuua se mea e tasi.

verses.en: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.sm: O karite foi, ma ‘au o saito mà solofanua, ma manu tele vavave, ua latou avatua i le mea sa i ai i latou e taitasi le tagata ma lona tofiga.

verses.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.sm: Ua foaiina mai e le Atua ia Solomona le poto ma le loto matala e matua tele lava, ma le loto e oo i mea e tele, e faapei o le oneone o i le matafaga.

verses.en: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.sm: Ua sili lava le poto o Solomona i le poto o tagata uma i sasae, ma le poto uma o Aikupito.

verses.en: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.sm: Ua sili lona poto i lo tagata uma; ilo Etano o lo sa Eserà, ma Hemana, ma Kalakolu, ma Tarata, o atalii o Makolo; na taʻua o ia i nuu uma na vagavagai.

verses.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.sm: O ana faataoto na ia faia e tolu afe ia; o ana pese foi ua tasile afe ma le lima.

verses.en: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.sm: Na tautala foi o ia i le uiga o laau e afua mai i le arasi o loo i Lepanona, e oo atu i le isopo ua tupu ae i le aupa; ua tautala foi o ia i le uiga o manu tataa, ma manu felelei, ma mea fetolofi, ma iʻa.

verses.en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.sm: Ua latou o mai e faalogologo i le poto o Solomona mai nuu uma, ma tupu uma o le lalolagi o e na logo atu i ai lona poto.
